description: Correctness #425: paired real-save Outpost connection-range scalar, not eligibility or geometry. RoyalG 1.22; genuine maps 1, 6 and 51 have Advanced Logistics levels 7, 6 and 4, with zero Guards on map 1 and one Guard on map 51. Selected Military ranks are all zero, so that direct rank is compared once. Cap999 and positive Military-rank contributions remain unobserved branches.
